Flash-sale booking and inventory: finding and removing the hot-stock bottleneck
Diagnose why the synchronous Book → Inventory lock → Payment path collapses during double-day promotions, calculate the hot-SKU threshold, and redesign admission, holds and payment for bounded load.

The pictured architecture serves one million daily users and roughly ten times normal promotional traffic, but the dangerous number is not daily users or total requests. Product pages multiply reads into inventory checks, while every buyer of one discounted SKU contends on the same stock record or Redis lock. The initial Book → Inventory → Payment chain couples failures: admission arrives too late, a payment command can be lost after a hold commits, and scaling pods cannot raise one hot key's serial capacity. This design makes the bottleneck measurable, gives Inventory one authoritative decision, and operates explicit low-traffic, pre-peak, surge, protection and recovery modes so each component is pre-warmed, autoscaled, capped or scaled in safely.
Serve product/search availability from a versioned projection; revalidate only when creating an authoritative hold.
Admission control: Admit a bounded number of checkout attempts per campaign/SKU and return sold-out, queued or retry-after responses before the inventory authority saturates.
Authoritative hold: Create an idempotent hold with quantity, fencing version and expiry using one atomic conditional write; never keep a database transaction open while calling payment.
Booking saga: Run authorize/capture and order confirmation as a durable saga, release expired or failed holds and reconcile unknown PSP outcomes.
Client-facing state: Expose campaign state, queue position and truthful pending/sold-out results so clients do not poll inventory aggressively.
Durable handoff: Commit stock, expiring hold and outbox together; emit hold-created/payment work only after commit, then return confirm-or-release commands to the Inventory authority.
Traffic lifecycle: Operate NORMAL, PRE_PEAK, SURGE, PROTECT and RECOVERY policies with versioned admission, DB/PSP budgets, user response and rollback owner.

Backpressure contract: Stop or slow producer work before the scarce boundary with bounded admission, in-flight holds, consumer pull/prefetch, deadlines, cancellation, Retry-After and load shedding; never hide overload in an unbounded queue.
Inventory invariant: Confirmed plus active-held quantity never exceeds sellable stock; Redis cache or lock loss cannot violate this invariant.
Overload isolation: Search remains available during checkout overload, and overload for one campaign/SKU cannot consume every DB connection or worker.
Idempotency boundary: The API is idempotent across client retry, gateway retry, queue redelivery and payment callback duplication.
Admission deadline: p99 hold latency stays within the admission deadline; once the queue cannot drain inside the business window, reject rather than hide demand in an unbounded backlog.
Audit trail: Every hold, expiry, payment and compensation transition is auditable and can be replayed or reconciled without mutating history.
Scale-in safety: A worker drains or checkpoints its current message before termination; scale-in cannot strand an active hold, unpublished outbox event or unknown payment.
Budget isolation: Browse, batch and analytics work have bounded DB/PSP concurrency so a scale-out in one path cannot consume the reservation budget.

Backpressure safety: When arrival rate exceeds drain rate, queue age and deadline misses stay bounded by rejecting, shedding or slowing work before DB connections, locks and PSP concurrency are exhausted.

Baseline: 1M DAU does not imply high throughput—uniform traffic is only 11.6 user arrivals/s, and the everyday planning figure is 250 rps peak (1M req/day). The launch window is a tier jump, not a peak: 50k users refreshing five times in 60 seconds produces about 4,167 edge requests/s before images and retries.

Read amplification: if a page checks 20 SKUs separately, 4,000 page requests/s becomes 80,000 inventory lookups/s. Batch the read, serve a denormalized projection/cache, and remove authoritative inventory from the browse path.

Hot-SKU serialization: capacity is approximately 1 / critical-section time. A 12 ms atomic reservation has a theoretical ceiling near 83 reservations/s for one serialized key; operate around 60–70% (about 50–58/s) to leave failover and variance headroom.

Hot-key slowdown: If lock/transaction time rises to 25 ms under WAL, replication or index pressure, the same SKU falls to 40/s theoretical and roughly 24–28/s safe. Ten application replicas do not raise this per-key limit; they only create more waiters.

Connection bound: 120 usable DB connections with 40 ms average transaction time suggests 3,000 tx/s only when work is independent. One hot row remains limited by its serial service time; if synchronous payment holds each connection for 0.8 s, the same pool has a theoretical ceiling of only 150 checkout/s.

Example admission: benchmark p99 atomic hold at 12 ms, choose 50 hold attempts/s per hot SKU, cap the waiting room at 10 seconds (500 admitted attempts), and reject/mark sold-out beyond it. These are planning numbers, not product guarantees.

Production limit: Find the real knee with a production-shaped pgbench/custom load test: Poisson arrivals plus a flash burst, realistic hot-SKU skew, WAL/replica settings and indexes. Increase target rate until schedule lag, p99 lock wait, serialization retry or error budget rises non-linearly; set the production limit below that point.

Capacity SLOs: DB pool below 70%, p99 lock wait below 20 ms, hold success response below 250 ms, post-admission backend queue age below 2 s, payment pending age bounded by provider SLA, and zero negative inventory.

Autoscaler gap: if a fleet needs 90 seconds to start and safe admission is 50/s while a campaign sends 2,000/s, an unbounded queue grows by roughly 175,500 requests before warm-up completes. Pre-warm known events; use the waiting room to bound unknown spikes.

Scaling vector: CDN, cache, search, gateways and independent workers scale with replicas; a viral SKU remains bounded by its 1 / critical-section rate. Measure and set a separate per-SKU admission cap rather than treating total RPS as capacity.

Scale-in gate: reduce capacity only after no active campaign, queue/outbox age is inside SLO, payment unknown and expiry backlog are draining, and p99/pool/lock signals are stable through a cooldown window.

Backpressure capacity check: admit only when drain_rate exceeds arrival_rate and estimated_drain_time fits the business window; otherwise cap the waiting room, shed low-priority work or return Retry-After instead of growing backlog.

Judge the pre-reservation layer per tier, because a flash sale is a tier jump rather than a traffic level: not needed at T1 and T2, where the conditional decrement alone absorbs the contention; mandatory at T3, since a sale concentrates a day of demand into minutes and the database is asked to serialize all of it; needs its own scaling story at T4, where the counter itself is sharded and the reconciliation between shard counters and the durable record becomes a component with an owner.
Traffic-lifecycle flash-sale architecture with authoritative inventory
Campaign/SKU policy — campaign_id, sku_id, sellable quota, per-user limit, admission rate, burst, start/end time and policy version.
Inventory position — sku/warehouse partition key, on_hand, reserved, sold, safety stock, monotonic version and last fencing token; enforce reserved + sold ≤ sellable in the authoritative transaction.
Hold — hold_id, sku, user, quantity, state, idempotency key/fingerprint, fencing version and expires_at; one active hold per business key where policy requires it.
Payment/order saga — own payment intent, hold reference, provider attempt, deadline and next action; pending and unknown are explicit states and it never shares an inventory transaction.
Reservation command — command_id, hold_id, sku_id, quantity, idempotency key, admission token and deadline; replay-safe at the booking boundary.
Distributed lock/fencing — lock key, owner, fencing token, lease deadline and authoritative inventory version; stale owners are rejected by the writer.
Inventory update event — event_id, sku_id, inventory_version, delta/state snapshot and occurred_at; partitioned by SKU for ordered projections.
Payment result event — payment_intent_id, order_id, provider_attempt, outcome, idempotency key and received_at; unknown is a first-class outcome.
Outbox/inbox — stable event ID, aggregate/version, payload schema and publish/consume status for idempotent propagation.
Capacity policy — campaign mode, warm-up window, min/max replicas, per-SKU admission rate, DB/PSP budget, cooldown and policy version; every mode change is auditable and reversible.
Worker drain lease — consumer, message/partition, visibility deadline, checkpoint and termination state; prevents scale-in from losing work or duplicating an external effect.
Availability projection — campaign/SKU, approximate remaining band, version and observed_at; optimized for browse and never authoritative for confirmation.

Edge waiting room/CDN — absorbs synchronized refreshes and releases signed admission tokens at a rate the checkout path has measured it can sustain; its bounded queue age is the first backpressure valve; alternative is immediate 429/sold-out for very short campaigns.
API gateway limiter — limits per campaign, SKU, account and device/API key; weighted checkout cost is more useful than IP-only request count behind NAT or bot networks.

PostgreSQL/MySQL inventory authority — conditional UPDATE or short SELECT FOR UPDATE transaction with unique constraints; preferred when oversell is unacceptable because correctness survives cache loss.

Redis — excellent for waiting-room counters, admission tokens, cached availability and optional atomic reservation when bounded loss/repair is explicitly accepted; a TTL lock alone is not the stock source of truth.

Booking lock/fencing — use a short-lived lock or single-writer SKU partition only around the reservation decision; attach a monotonically increasing fencing token so a paused owner cannot write after lease expiry.

Inventory-update MQ — publish the committed stock/hold change through a transactional outbox; partition by SKU, process at least once, dedupe by event ID/version and route poison messages to a visible DLQ.
Payment-result MQ — PSP adapters publish authorized, failed, canceled or unknown results; consumers advance the order state idempotently and reconcile unknown outcomes before release/refund.
Payment guard — use idempotency key + unique payment intent + versioned state transition as the payment lock; never hold the inventory lock or DB transaction while waiting for PSP.
Kafka/RabbitMQ plus transactional outbox — notification, projection and analytics leave the reservation transaction; consumers are idempotent and expose oldest-message age and DLQ ownership.
Durable workflow/orchestrator — owns hold → payment → confirm/release deadlines and status queries; cron-only compensation is simpler but reacts slowly and hides per-order progress.

Scheduled pre-warm — for predictable campaigns, raise the critical path's minimum replicas, cache working set and connection budget before the start time; measure startup/warm-up rather than assuming reactive autoscaling is instant.

Per-component autoscaling — scale UI/API from concurrency or requests/target, queue workers from oldest-message age plus per-partition lag, and payment from pending age; cap each by its DB/PSP downstream budget.

Drain-first scale-in — remove only idle/stateless capacity after queue/outbox/payment/expiry gates are healthy; workers stop pulling, finish or checkpoint, then release their lease before termination.

Cost tiers — analytics, reindex and bulk notifications may scale to zero; checkout API/payment floor, inventory authority, outbox, expiry, callback receiver and HA data stores must retain a minimum safe capacity.
Observability — trace admission-to-hold-to-payment, measure per-SKU lock wait/attempt/success without SKU as an unbounded metric label, and log sampled high-cardinality campaign/SKU details.

Synchronous boundary should end after the authoritative hold decision: admission, booking and inventory write return held/queued/sold-out. Payment authorization and result delivery cross an asynchronous saga boundary, so the API can return pending without holding a connection.

Booking lock/fencing protects the short concurrent write, but a distributed lock must never span the PSP call. Payment uses an idempotency guard and versioned state machine instead; otherwise a slow PSP turns lock expiry into double-spend or oversell risk.

Inventory-update and payment-result MQs improve isolation but are at-least-once. Ordering is per aggregate/SKU, not global; require event IDs, inbox dedupe, retry with backoff, DLQ ownership and reconciliation dashboards.

Reactive autoscaling saves steady-state cost but acts after measurement, scheduling and warm-up. Scheduled pre-warm costs idle capacity yet is the only reliable response for a campaign whose launch minute is already known.

Scale-out must use a component's own proportional signal: CPU/request concurrency for stateless APIs, oldest event age and partition skew for workers, and DB/PSP budgets as hard caps. A single global CPU target hides the first saturated dependency.

Scale-to-zero is attractive for analytics, reindex and bulk notification, but wrong for the inventory authority, hold expiry, outbox relay, PSP callback and reconciliation paths. Their idle cost buys correctness and a bounded recovery time.

The original shared Book+Payment database minimizes early hops but couples deployments, pools and failures. Separate Inventory/Hold ownership from Payment/Order saga ownership; connect them with outbox events rather than an implicit cross-DB transaction.
A cache or read replica removes browse load, not a hot inventory write. A quota bucket/cell or single-writer lane can isolate a viral SKU, but adds stranded quota, fairness and reconciliation costs.

Synchronous payment gives a final response but holds threads, connections and possibly stock during the slowest dependency. A saga returns pending sooner and adds idempotency, reconciliation and a more complex user contract.

Database conditional updates give the clearest invariant and a per-hot-key serial ceiling. Redis atomic scripts are faster but move durability, failover and repair assumptions into application correctness.
A waiting room protects the system and improves fairness, but exact queue position is expensive and misleading under abandonment; return a band or estimated wait instead.

A longer hold TTL improves checkout completion while reducing inventory utilization and enabling hoarding. Use a short base TTL, per-user caps and policy-controlled extension after payment authorization begins.

Partitioning by SKU spreads different products but never scales one viral SKU. For that key, reduce critical-section time, pre-split a quota into fenced buckets or serialize commands in one partition and accept bounded throughput.

Pre-allocating stock to cells/regions removes a global write hop and contains failure, but stranded quota can show sold-out in one cell while another has stock; rebalance only through fenced quota transfer.

Queueing/backpressure smooths a burst only when drain rate exceeds sustainable arrivals soon enough. If 2,000 attempts/s enter a 50/s hot-SKU worker, backlog grows 1,950/s; after ten seconds it already needs about 390 seconds to drain, so bounded admission and rejection are the honest response.

Failure review: test Redis loss, DB primary failover, an expired hold racing with payment success, duplicated payment callbacks, outbox lag, bot-distributed identities and a client retry storm after a gateway timeout.

What invariant can break, and what keeps it true?

The only non-negotiable invariant is confirmed plus active-held quantity never exceeding sellable stock. Inventory DB is the write authority: one conditional reservation write commits position, hold and outbox together; cache, Redis lock and projections are never allowed to confirm stock. If reconciliation detects a mismatch, freeze admission for that SKU and repair from immutable hold, order and PSP evidence rather than editing the stock counter by hand.
Which signal detects the incident before customers see a collapse?

Alert on the first saturated boundary, not aggregate CPU: p99 inventory lock wait above 20 ms, hold latency above 250 ms, usable DB pool above 70%, post-admission queue age above 2 s, hot-partition lag, PSP unknown age and attempt-to-original retry ratio. The campaign dashboard must show these per campaign and sampled hot SKU, with a named owner who can move the mode to PROTECT.
How is the blast radius contained during a hot SKU or dependency failure?

Admission is capped per campaign/SKU before Book and Inventory; checkout has bounded DB and PSP concurrency separate from browse, batch and analytics. In PROTECT, lower the SKU admission rate, stop optional work, serve cached approximate availability and return queued, retry-after or sold-out instead of accumulating an unbounded backend queue. Search stays available because it never calls the authoritative stock write path.
Can retries duplicate, reorder or incorrectly finalize work?

A client idempotency key maps to one hold, payment intent and terminal response; event IDs plus inbox dedupe make MQ redelivery harmless. Ordering is only per SKU/aggregate, so every state transition checks its expected version and a stale confirm/release is rejected. PSP timeout becomes PAYMENT_UNKNOWN: query and reconcile the provider before capture retry, release or refund; never use a Redis lease as proof that a payment may be repeated.
How do we prove recovery after Redis loss, DB failover or a partial saga?

Rebuild projections from the inventory outbox, replay idempotently by aggregate/version, and compare every active hold with payment/order saga and PSP records. The expiry worker reconciles old holds, while a dedicated unknown-payment job queries the PSP and emits one fenced confirm, release or refund decision. Recovery is complete only when the reconciliation diff is zero, queue/outbox and expiry age return inside SLO, and the audit trail can explain each stock transition.

Flash-sale booking & inventory: tìm và gỡ hot-inventory bottleneck
Phân tích vì sao synchronous Book → lock Inventory → Payment sụp ở peak, tính hot-SKU limit và redesign admission, hold, payment theo bounded load.

Architecture này phục vụ 1M DAU và khoảng 10× traffic trong campaign, nhưng con số nguy hiểm không phải DAU hay total requests. Product page amplify read thành nhiều inventory check, trong khi mọi buyer của một discounted SKU cùng tranh chấp một stock row hoặc Redis lock. Chuỗi ban đầu Book → Inventory → Payment ghép failure lại với nhau: admission đến quá muộn, payment command có thể mất sau khi hold commit và scale pod không thể tăng serial capacity của một hot key. Design này biến bottleneck thành số đo được, giữ Inventory là authoritative decision duy nhất và vận hành explicit mode low-traffic, pre-peak, surge, protect, recovery để mỗi component được pre-warm, autoscale, cap hoặc scale-in an toàn.
Serve availability cho product/search từ projection có version; chỉ revalidate khi tạo hold authoritative.
Kiểm soát admission: Admit số checkout attempt hữu hạn theo campaign/SKU và trả sold-out, queued hoặc retry-after trước khi inventory authority saturation.
Hold authoritative: Tạo hold idempotent có quantity, fencing version và expiry bằng một atomic conditional write; không giữ database transaction khi gọi payment.
Booking saga: Chạy authorize/capture và order confirmation bằng durable saga, release hold hết hạn/thất bại và reconcile PSP outcome mơ hồ.
Trạng thái cho client: Expose campaign state, queue position và pending/sold-out trung thực để client không poll inventory hung hãn.
Handoff bền vững: Commit stock, hold có expiry và outbox cùng nhau; chỉ phát hold-created/payment work sau commit, rồi gửi command confirm/release về Inventory authority.
Traffic lifecycle: Vận hành policy NORMAL, PRE_PEAK, SURGE, PROTECT và RECOVERY có versioned admission, DB/PSP budget, user response và rollback owner.

Backpressure contract: Dừng hoặc làm chậm producer trước scarce boundary bằng bounded admission, in-flight hold, consumer pull/prefetch, deadline, cancellation, Retry-After và load shedding; không giấu overload trong queue vô hạn.
Invariant inventory: Tổng confirmed và active-held không vượt sellable stock; mất Redis cache/lock không được làm vỡ invariant này.
Cô lập quá tải: Search vẫn available khi checkout overload, và overload của một campaign/SKU không ăn hết DB connection hoặc worker.
Ranh giới idempotency: API idempotent qua client retry, gateway retry, queue redelivery và payment callback duplicate.
Hạn admission: p99 hold latency nằm trong admission deadline; khi queue không drain kịp business window phải reject thay vì giấu demand trong backlog vô hạn.
Dấu vết audit: Mọi transition hold, expiry, payment và compensation đều audit/replay/reconcile được mà không mutate history.
Scale-in an toàn: Worker drain hoặc checkpoint message hiện tại trước terminate; scale-in không được làm stranded active hold, outbox chưa publish hoặc payment unknown.
Cô lập budget: Browse, batch và analytics có DB/PSP concurrency hữu hạn để scale-out một path không ăn reservation budget.
Backpressure safety: Khi arrival rate vượt drain rate, queue age và deadline miss vẫn hữu hạn bằng cách reject, shed hoặc làm chậm work trước khi DB connection, lock và PSP concurrency cạn.

Baseline: 1M DAU không đồng nghĩa throughput cao — nếu đều chỉ là 11,6 user arrival/s, và con số planning ngày thường là 250 rps peak (1M req/day). Launch window là một cú nhảy tier, không phải peak: 50k user refresh năm lần trong 60 giây tạo khoảng 4.167 edge request/s, chưa tính image và retry.

Read amplification: nếu mỗi page check riêng 20 SKU, 4.000 page request/s biến thành 80.000 inventory lookup/s. Phải batch read, serve projection/cache denormalized và bỏ inventory authoritative khỏi browse path.

Hot-SKU serialization: capacity xấp xỉ 1 / thời gian critical section. Atomic reservation 12 ms có trần lý thuyết gần 83 reservation/s cho một key serialized; chỉ vận hành 60–70% (khoảng 50–58/s) để chừa headroom cho variance/failover.

Chậm ở hot key: Nếu lock/transaction tăng lên 25 ms do WAL, replication hoặc index pressure, cùng SKU chỉ còn 40/s lý thuyết và khoảng 24–28/s an toàn. Mười app replica không tăng per-key limit; chúng chỉ tạo thêm waiter.

Connection bound: 120 DB connection dùng được với average transaction time 40 ms gợi ý 3.000 tx/s chỉ khi work độc lập. Một hot row vẫn bị giới hạn bởi serial service time; nếu synchronous payment giữ mỗi connection 0,8 giây thì cùng pool chỉ còn trần lý thuyết 150 checkout/s.

Ví dụ admission: benchmark p99 atomic hold 12 ms, chọn 50 hold attempt/s cho mỗi hot SKU, cap waiting room 10 giây (500 attempt đã admit), reject/mark sold-out phần vượt. Đây là planning number, không phải guarantee chung.

Giới hạn production: Tìm knee thật bằng pgbench/custom load test giống production: Poisson arrival cộng flash burst, hot-SKU skew thật, WAL/replica/index thật. Tăng target rate tới khi schedule lag, p99 lock wait, serialization retry hoặc error budget tăng phi tuyến; đặt production limit thấp hơn điểm đó.
Capacity SLO: DB pool dưới 70%, p99 lock wait dưới 20 ms, hold response dưới 250 ms, post-admission backend queue age dưới 2 giây, payment pending age theo provider SLA và zero negative inventory.

Khoảng trống autoscaler: Nếu fleet cần 90 giây để start và safe admission là 50/s trong khi campaign gửi 2.000/s, queue vô hạn tăng khoảng 175.500 request trước khi warm-up xong. Campaign có lịch phải pre-warm; spike không biết trước phải bị waiting room chặn hữu hạn.

Scaling vector: CDN, cache, search, gateway và worker độc lập scale theo replica; một SKU viral vẫn bị chặn bởi 1 / critical-section time. Đo và đặt per-SKU admission cap riêng thay vì xem total RPS là capacity.
Gate scale-in: Chỉ giảm capacity khi không có active campaign, queue/outbox age trong SLO, payment unknown và expiry backlog đang drain, p99/pool/lock ổn định qua cooldown window.

Backpressure capacity check: Chỉ admit khi drain_rate lớn hơn arrival_rate và estimated_drain_time nằm trong business window; nếu không thì cap waiting room, shed work ít ưu tiên hoặc trả Retry-After thay vì để backlog phình.

Hãy đánh giá tầng giữ chỗ trước theo từng tier, vì một đợt flash sale là một cú nhảy tier chứ không phải một mức traffic: không cần ở T1 và T2, nơi riêng lệnh trừ có điều kiện đã hấp thụ hết tranh chấp; bắt buộc ở T3, vì một đợt bán dồn nhu cầu cả ngày vào vài phút và database bị bắt tuần tự hoá toàn bộ chừng đó; cần scale riêng ở T4, nơi chính bộ đếm cũng bị shard và việc đối soát giữa các bộ đếm shard với bản ghi bền vững trở thành một thành phần có người sở hữu.
Kiến trúc flash-sale theo traffic lifecycle với inventory authoritative
Campaign/SKU policy — campaign_id, sku_id, sellable quota, per-user limit, admission rate/burst, start/end và policy version.
Inventory position — partition key sku/warehouse, on_hand, reserved, sold, safety stock, monotonic version và last fencing token; enforce reserved + sold ≤ sellable trong transaction authoritative.
Hold — hold_id, sku, user, quantity, state, idempotency key/fingerprint, fencing version và expires_at; một active hold trên mỗi business key khi policy yêu cầu.
Payment/order saga — sở hữu payment intent, hold reference, provider attempt, deadline và next action; pending/unknown là state rõ ràng và không share inventory transaction.
Reservation command — command_id, hold_id, sku_id, quantity, idempotency key, admission token và deadline; replay-safe ở booking boundary.
Distributed lock/fencing — lock key, owner, fencing token, lease deadline và inventory version authoritative; writer từ owner cũ sẽ bị reject.
Inventory update event — event_id, sku_id, inventory_version, delta/state snapshot và occurred_at; partition theo SKU để projection có thứ tự.
Payment result event — payment_intent_id, order_id, provider_attempt, outcome, idempotency key và received_at; unknown là outcome chính thức.
Outbox/inbox — stable event ID, aggregate/version, payload schema và publish/consume status cho propagation idempotent.
Capacity policy — campaign mode, warm-up window, min/max replica, per-SKU admission rate, DB/PSP budget, cooldown và policy version; mọi mode change audit/rollback được.
Worker drain lease — consumer, message/partition, visibility deadline, checkpoint và termination state; ngăn scale-in làm mất work hoặc duplicate external effect.
Availability projection — campaign/SKU, approximate remaining band, version và observed_at; tối ưu browse và không authoritative khi confirm.

Edge waiting room/CDN — hấp thụ synchronized refresh và phát signed admission token theo rate checkout path đã đo là chịu được; bounded queue age là van backpressure đầu tiên; campaign rất ngắn có thể chọn 429/sold-out ngay.
API gateway limiter — limit theo campaign, SKU, account và device/API key; weighted checkout cost hữu ích hơn IP-only count sau NAT hoặc bot network.
PostgreSQL/MySQL inventory authority — conditional UPDATE hoặc transaction SELECT FOR UPDATE rất ngắn kèm unique constraint; phù hợp khi không chấp nhận oversell vì correctness sống qua cache loss.

Redis — phù hợp cho waiting-room counter, admission token, cached availability và optional atomic reservation nếu bounded loss/repair được chấp nhận rõ; TTL lock đơn lẻ không phải stock source of truth.
Booking lock/fencing — dùng lock ngắn hoặc single-writer SKU partition chỉ quanh quyết định reservation; gắn fencing token tăng dần để owner bị pause không thể ghi sau khi lease hết hạn.
Inventory-update MQ — publish stock/hold change đã commit qua transactional outbox; partition theo SKU, xử lý at-least-once, dedupe theo event ID/version và đưa poison message vào DLQ nhìn thấy được.
Payment-result MQ — PSP adapter publish authorized, failed, canceled hoặc unknown; consumer tiến state order idempotent và reconcile unknown trước khi release/refund.
Payment guard — dùng idempotency key + unique payment intent + versioned state transition làm payment lock; không giữ inventory lock hay DB transaction khi chờ PSP.
Kafka/RabbitMQ + transactional outbox — đưa notification, projection và analytics ra khỏi reservation transaction; consumer idempotent, quan sát oldest-message age và có DLQ owner.
Durable workflow/orchestrator — sở hữu deadline hold → payment → confirm/release và status query; cron-only compensation đơn giản hơn nhưng phản ứng chậm, giấu progress từng order.
Scheduled pre-warm — campaign có lịch phải nâng min replica critical path, cache working set và connection budget trước giờ mở; đo startup/warm-up thay vì tin reactive autoscale là tức thì.

Autoscaling theo component — UI/API scale từ concurrency hoặc requests/target, queue worker từ oldest-message age cộng per-partition lag, payment từ pending age; mỗi path bị cap bởi DB/PSP downstream budget.
Drain-first scale-in — chỉ bỏ capacity idle/stateless khi gate queue/outbox/payment/expiry khỏe; worker stop pulling, finish/checkpoint rồi release lease trước terminate.

Cost tier — analytics, reindex, bulk notification có thể scale-to-zero; checkout API/payment floor, inventory authority, outbox, expiry, callback receiver và HA datastore phải giữ minimum safe capacity.
Observability — trace admission-to-hold-to-payment, đo lock wait/attempt/success theo SKU mà không dùng SKU làm metric label vô hạn, log high-cardinality campaign/SKU theo sampling.

Ranh giới synchronous nên kết thúc sau authoritative hold: admission, booking và inventory write trả held/queued/sold-out. Payment authorization và result đi qua async saga, API trả pending mà không giữ connection.

Booking lock/fencing bảo vệ concurrent write ngắn, nhưng distributed lock tuyệt đối không được kéo qua PSP. Payment dùng idempotency guard và state machine có version; nếu không PSP chậm sẽ biến lock expiry thành rủi ro double-spend/oversell.

Hai MQ inventory-update và payment-result tăng isolation nhưng là at-least-once. Ordering chỉ bảo đảm theo aggregate/SKU, không global; cần event ID, inbox dedupe, retry backoff, DLQ owner và dashboard reconciliation.

Reactive autoscaling tiết kiệm steady-state cost nhưng chỉ hành động sau measurement, scheduling và warm-up. Scheduled pre-warm tốn idle capacity nhưng là phản ứng đáng tin duy nhất khi đã biết launch minute của campaign.

Scale-out phải dùng proportional signal riêng từng component: CPU/request concurrency cho API stateless, oldest event age và partition skew cho worker, DB/PSP budget là hard cap. Một global CPU target che dependency saturated đầu tiên.

Scale-to-zero hấp dẫn cho analytics, reindex và bulk notification nhưng sai với inventory authority, hold expiry, outbox relay, PSP callback và reconciliation. Idle cost của chúng mua correctness và bounded recovery time.

Shared Book+Payment database ban đầu giảm hop nhưng ghép deployment, pool và failure. Tách ownership Inventory/Hold khỏi Payment/Order saga; nối bằng outbox event thay vì implicit cross-DB transaction.
Cache hoặc read replica gỡ browse load, không gỡ hot inventory write. Quota bucket/cell hoặc single-writer lane có thể isolate viral SKU nhưng thêm stranded quota, fairness và reconciliation cost.

Synchronous payment trả final response nhưng giữ thread, connection và có thể cả stock qua dependency chậm nhất. Saga trả pending sớm hơn nhưng thêm idempotency, reconciliation và user contract phức tạp.
Database conditional update cho invariant rõ nhất và có serial ceiling theo hot key. Redis atomic script nhanh hơn nhưng đưa assumption durability, failover và repair vào correctness của application.
Waiting room bảo vệ hệ thống và tăng fairness, nhưng exact queue position đắt và gây hiểu nhầm khi user abandon; nên trả range hoặc estimated wait.
Hold TTL dài tăng checkout completion nhưng giảm inventory utilization và tạo cơ hội hoarding. Dùng base TTL ngắn, per-user cap và chỉ extend theo policy sau khi bắt đầu payment authorization.

Partition theo SKU phân tán các product khác nhau nhưng không scale một viral SKU. Với key đó phải giảm critical-section time, pre-split quota thành fenced bucket hoặc serialize command trong một partition và chấp nhận bounded throughput.

Pre-allocate stock theo cell/region bỏ global write hop và giới hạn blast radius, nhưng quota có thể mắc kẹt khiến một cell báo sold-out trong khi cell khác còn hàng; chỉ rebalance qua fenced quota transfer.

Queue/backpressure chỉ làm phẳng burst nếu drain rate sớm vượt sustainable arrival. Nếu 2.000 attempt/s vào worker hot-SKU 50/s, backlog tăng 1.950/s; sau 10 giây đã cần khoảng 390 giây để drain, vì vậy bounded admission và reject mới là phản hồi trung thực.

Failure review: test Redis loss, DB primary failover, expired hold race với payment success, duplicate payment callback, outbox lag, bot dùng distributed identity và client retry storm sau gateway timeout.
Admission atomic cho hot SKU
Redis chạy admission check rẻ và atomic; Inventory DB vẫn là source of truth cuối cùng.
Invariant nào có thể vỡ và điều gì giữ nó đúng?

Invariant không được phá là confirmed cộng active-held không bao giờ vượt sellable stock. Inventory DB là write authority: một conditional reservation write commit position, hold và outbox cùng transaction; cache, Redis lock hay projection không bao giờ được confirm stock. Nếu reconciliation thấy lệch, freeze admission của SKU đó và repair bằng bằng chứng immutable từ hold, order và PSP, không sửa tay stock counter.
Tín hiệu nào phát hiện incident trước khi khách thấy hệ thống sụp?

Alert ở boundary saturated đầu tiên, không nhìn CPU tổng: p99 inventory lock wait trên 20 ms, hold latency trên 250 ms, usable DB pool trên 70%, post-admission queue age trên 2 giây, hot-partition lag, PSP unknown age và tỉ lệ retry/original attempt. Campaign dashboard phải hiển thị theo campaign và hot SKU được sample, kèm owner có quyền chuyển mode sang PROTECT.
Blast radius được contain thế nào khi hot SKU hoặc dependency lỗi?

Admission bị cap theo campaign/SKU trước Book và Inventory; checkout có DB/PSP concurrency hữu hạn, tách khỏi browse, batch và analytics. Ở PROTECT, giảm SKU admission rate, dừng optional work, serve cached approximate availability và trả queued, retry-after hoặc sold-out thay vì tích backend queue vô hạn. Search vẫn available vì không gọi authoritative stock write path.
Retry có thể duplicate, reorder hoặc finalize sai không?

Client idempotency key map vào một hold, payment intent và terminal response; event ID cộng inbox dedupe làm MQ redelivery vô hại. Ordering chỉ theo SKU/aggregate nên mọi state transition kiểm expected version và stale confirm/release bị reject. PSP timeout thành PAYMENT_UNKNOWN: query và reconcile provider trước khi capture retry, release hoặc refund; không dùng Redis lease làm bằng chứng payment được phép lặp.
Làm sao chứng minh recovery sau Redis loss, DB failover hoặc saga dang dở?

Rebuild projection từ inventory outbox, replay idempotent theo aggregate/version, rồi đối chiếu từng active hold với payment/order saga và PSP record. Expiry worker reconcile hold cũ; unknown-payment job query PSP và phát đúng một fenced decision confirm, release hoặc refund. Recovery chỉ hoàn tất khi reconciliation diff bằng 0, queue/outbox/expiry age về lại SLO và audit trail giải thích được từng stock transition.

A flash sale has 50,000 visitors refreshing five times in 60 seconds. One hot SKU has a 12 ms atomic-hold benchmark. Design a bounded admission and reservation path: calculate the useful per-SKU limit, decide what the client sees, and preserve inventory when demand is far above capacity.

**Size the hot key:** `50,000 × 5 / 60 ≈ 4,167` edge requests/sec. A 12 ms serialized hold has a theoretical ceiling near 83/sec, so admit about 50/sec for failover and variance headroom—not thousands because more app replicas exist.

A ten-second waiting room therefore holds at most about 500 admitted attempts; beyond that, return an honest queued range, `Retry-After`, or sold-out result.

**Protect the authority:** Scope signed admission to campaign, SKU, account, and device/API key. Browse reads a versioned availability projection, while a short database conditional write enforces `reserved + sold ≤ sellable` and creates an idempotent, expiring hold.

A Redis TTL lock is not the stock authority.

**Keep payment outside:** The durable saga calls the PSP after the hold transaction and exposes `PENDING`. Watch queue age, p99 lock wait, hold success, DB-pool use, and negative inventory; reject when the queue cannot clear inside the sale window.

**Case metadata:**
- **Workload:** refresh rate, hot-SKU demand, admission throughput, hold latency and payment drain rate
- **Freshness:** availability projection may lag but hold authority is current
- **Duplicate tolerance:** admission token, request key, hold/order key and provider key
- **Recovery owner:** admission, inventory and payment/reconciliation owners

**Failure matrix:**

| Window | Incorrect shortcut | Required state and owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admission burst exceeds the measured hold lane | Admit all visitors because app replicas scale | Queue or reject with an honest bound; admission owner protects the inventory budget |
| Hold worker times out | Retry with a new hold ID | Reuse the request/hold key and return the recorded `PENDING`/conflict state |
| Database/pool saturation | Add a Redis lock and continue accepting | Apply backpressure/load shedding and watch the authoritative negative-inventory invariant |

Một flash sale có 50.000 visitor refresh năm lần trong 60 giây. Một hot SKU có benchmark atomic hold 12 ms. Hãy thiết kế đường admission và reservation hữu hạn: tính limit hữu ích theo SKU, quyết định client nhìn thấy gì, và giữ inventory đúng khi demand vượt xa capacity.

**Định cỡ hot key:** `50.000 × 5 / 60 ≈ 4.167` edge request/giây. Hold tuần tự 12 ms có trần lý thuyết gần 83/giây, nên chỉ admit khoảng 50/giây để chừa headroom cho failover và variance—không phải hàng nghìn chỉ vì tăng app replica.

Waiting room mười giây vì thế chỉ giữ khoảng 500 attempt đã admit; phần vượt phải nhận queued range trung thực, `Retry-After` hoặc sold-out.

**Bảo vệ authority:** Scope signed admission theo campaign, SKU, account và device/API key. Browse đọc availability projection có version; database conditional write ngắn mới enforce `reserved + sold ≤ sellable` và tạo hold idempotent có expiry. Redis TTL lock không phải stock authority.

**Để payment ở ngoài:** Durable saga gọi PSP sau hold transaction và expose `PENDING`. Theo dõi queue age, p99 lock wait, hold success, DB-pool use và negative inventory; reject khi queue không thể giải toả trong sale window.

**Metadata của case:**
- **Workload:** refresh rate, nhu cầu hot-SKU, admission throughput, hold latency và payment drain rate
- **Freshness:** availability projection có thể trễ nhưng hold authority là current
- **Duplicate tolerance:** admission token, request key, hold/order key và provider key
- **Recovery owner:** admission, inventory và payment/reconciliation owner

**Failure matrix:**

| Cửa sổ lỗi | Shortcut sai | State và owner cần có |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admission burst vượt hold lane đo được | Admit mọi visitor vì app replica scale được | Queue hoặc reject với bound trung thực; admission owner bảo vệ inventory budget |
| Hold worker timeout | Retry với hold ID mới | Dùng lại request/hold key và trả state `PENDING`/conflict đã ghi |
| Database/pool saturation | Thêm Redis lock rồi tiếp tục nhận | Backpressure/load shedding và theo dõi invariant negative-inventory tại authority |

During a flash sale, Redis is lost, an expired hold races with delayed PSP success, and the gateway, client, and payment webhook all retry. Define the authoritative state, idempotency boundary, expiry rule, and reconciliation path so neither oversell nor a duplicate charge can occur.

**Authority survives cache loss:** The inventory row and hold/order state machine are authoritative. A short conditional transaction enforces `confirmed + active-held ≤ sellable`; every transition carries an expected version or fencing value.

Redis may rebuild waiting-room counters and availability projections, but its loss cannot alter stock.

**One intent, one provider attempt:** Persist the client idempotency key and request fingerprint with the hold/order, then create an outbox event. The PSP worker uses one stable provider idempotency key; a timeout is `UNKNOWN`, never permission to issue a second independent charge.

Webhooks, polls, and queue deliveries are recorded idempotently.

**Resolve races explicitly:** An expiry worker releases only the matching still-active version.

A late PSP success may not silently confirm an expired hold: reload authority, query the provider, then confirm only if policy and stock allow it; otherwise cancel/refund or compensate through a new recorded transition.

Monitor unknown-payment age, outbox lag, duplicate rates, and reconciliation debt.

**Case metadata:**
- **Workload:** Redis-loss rate, hold expiry, PSP latency, retry/webhook volume and hot-SKU skew
- **Freshness:** inventory/order authority is current while waiting-room/cache/PSP views have explicit lag budgets
- **Duplicate tolerance:** client key, hold version, provider key and webhook/event ID
- **Recovery owner:** inventory, payment and reconciliation service

**State transition guard:** A bounded model is `ACTIVE_HOLD -> EXPIRED | RELEASED | CONFIRMED`; `PENDING | UNKNOWN -> CONFIRMED | FAILED | RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED`; and `late success -> COMPENSATING -> REFUNDED | RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED`. Redis loss never authorizes a stock transition.

**Failure matrix:**

| Window | Incorrect shortcut | Required state and owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Redis disappears during admission/hold | Recreate a hold from cache state | Re-read the inventory authority and fence stale workers |
| PSP success races expiry | Confirm on callback arrival | Compare hold version and policy; refund/compensate when stock is no longer confirmable |
| Gateway, client and webhook all retry | Charge once per transport attempt | Correlate one intent to one provider key and reconcile unknown age |

**Canonical boundary:** Use (09-distributed-tx-fintech.correctness-where-money-is-involved.q2), (25-microservice.09-idempotency-the-central-link.q2) and (15-transactional-outbox-order-workflow) for mechanism details; keep this prompt focused on the flash-sale authority and race policy.

Trong flash sale, Redis bị mất, hold hết hạn chạy đua với PSP success đến muộn, còn gateway, client và payment webhook đều retry. Hãy định nghĩa authoritative state, idempotency boundary, expiry rule và reconciliation path để không oversell cũng không charge trùng.

**Authority sống qua cache loss:** Inventory row cùng state machine hold/order là authoritative. Conditional transaction ngắn enforce `confirmed + active-held ≤ sellable`; mọi transition đều mang expected version hoặc fencing value.

Redis có thể dựng lại waiting-room counter và availability projection, nhưng mất Redis không được làm đổi stock.

**Một intent, một provider attempt:** Persist client idempotency key và request fingerprint với hold/order, rồi tạo outbox event. PSP worker dùng một provider idempotency key ổn định; timeout là `UNKNOWN`, không phải quyền tạo một charge độc lập thứ hai.

Webhook, polling và queue delivery đều được ghi idempotent.

**Giải race tường minh:** Expiry worker chỉ release đúng version vẫn active. PSP success đến muộn không được tự confirm hold đã hết hạn: đọc lại authority, query provider, rồi chỉ confirm nếu policy và stock cho phép; nếu không thì cancel/refund hoặc compensate bằng transition mới có record.

Theo dõi tuổi payment unknown, outbox lag, duplicate rate và reconciliation debt.

**Metadata của case:**
- **Workload:** tần suất Redis loss, hold expiry, PSP latency, retry/webhook volume và hot-SKU skew
- **Freshness:** inventory/order authority là current còn waiting-room/cache/PSP view có lag budget rõ
- **Duplicate tolerance:** client key, hold version, provider key và webhook/event ID
- **Recovery owner:** inventory, payment và reconciliation service

**Guard của state transition:** Một model có bound là `ACTIVE_HOLD -> EXPIRED | RELEASED | CONFIRMED`; `PENDING | UNKNOWN -> CONFIRMED | FAILED | RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED`; và `late success -> COMPENSATING -> REFUNDED | RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED`. Redis loss không bao giờ cấp quyền chuyển stock.

**Failure matrix:**

| Cửa sổ lỗi | Shortcut sai | State và owner cần có |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Redis biến mất giữa admission/hold | Tạo lại hold từ cache state | Đọc lại inventory authority và fence stale worker |
| PSP success race expiry | Confirm theo arrival callback | So hold version và policy; refund/compensate khi stock không còn confirm được |
| Gateway, client và webhook cùng retry | Charge một lần cho mỗi transport attempt | Correlate một intent với một provider key và reconcile unknown age |

Flash-sale capacity and hot-key contention
A campaign is an open-loop burst against one scarce key. Measure the serialized reservation path, then admit no faster than it can safely drain.
Find the knee, not a vendor TPS
Replay the real reservation transaction with hot-key skew and target-rate arrivals. Track schedule lag, lock wait, deadlock/serialization retry, WAL latency and pool occupancy together.
The first nonlinear rise in p99 or schedule lag is the saturation knee. Keep production admission below it with headroom; rerun after schema, index, hardware or durability changes.
Separate popularity from correctness
Browse reads use a cached projection and may show an availability band. Only the hold command touches authoritative stock, so a refresh storm cannot become a row-lock storm.

A Redis reservation script is atomic inside Redis but still needs an explicit durability/recovery contract. For zero-oversell inventory, a database invariant or fenced single-writer authority remains the final judge.
Bound demand before work starts
Issue admission tokens per campaign/SKU, cap concurrent holds and give the queue a maximum waiting age. Reject when estimated drain time exceeds the useful checkout window.
Load-test client retries and bots, not only cooperative users. A timeout without Retry-After or a truthful pending state can multiply attempts exactly when capacity is lowest.
Capacity flash sale và contention trên hot key
Campaign là open-loop burst đánh vào một key khan hiếm. Phải đo reservation path serialized rồi chỉ admit ở rate mà nó drain an toàn.
Find the knee, không dùng vendor TPS
Replay transaction reservation thật với hot-key skew và target-rate arrival. Theo dõi đồng thời schedule lag, lock wait, deadlock/serialization retry, WAL latency và pool occupancy.
Điểm p99 hoặc schedule lag bắt đầu tăng phi tuyến là saturation knee. Đặt admission production thấp hơn có headroom; benchmark lại sau thay đổi schema, index, hardware hoặc durability.
Separate popularity khỏi correctness
Browse read dùng cached projection và có thể hiện availability band. Chỉ hold command chạm stock authoritative để refresh storm không biến thành row-lock storm.

Redis reservation script atomic bên trong Redis nhưng vẫn cần durability/recovery contract. Với inventory không chấp nhận oversell, database invariant hoặc fenced single-writer authority vẫn là quyết định cuối.
Bound demand trước khi tạo work
Phát admission token theo campaign/SKU, cap concurrent hold và đặt maximum waiting age. Reject khi estimated drain time vượt checkout window còn hữu ích.
Load-test cả client retry và bot, không chỉ cooperative user. Timeout thiếu Retry-After hoặc pending state trung thực sẽ nhân số attempt đúng lúc capacity thấp nhất.

Elastic capacity across the traffic lifecycle

Scale-out is useful only for work that can run in parallel. Known peaks need scheduled warm capacity; quiet periods need deliberate, drain-safe scale-in rather than an indiscriminate scale-to-zero policy.
Pre-warm known peaks; bound unknown spikes

For a scheduled campaign, raise the critical-path floor before launch using measured startup, cache warm-up and connection-pool time. Reactive autoscaling begins after demand is observed, so admission control must cover the warm-up gap.
For surprise traffic, scale gateway, read path and stateless APIs from concurrency/request signals, but issue no more checkout work than the inventory, database and PSP budgets can safely drain.
Use one scaling signal per component

UI/API capacity follows request concurrency or requests per healthy target; queue consumers need oldest-message age, input/output rate and partition skew; payment workers also need a provider-concurrency cap.

A hot SKU, shared row, database lock or one ordered partition is a synchronization point. More replicas reduce surrounding work but do not raise that key’s serialized rate; use admission, quotas, cells or a single-writer lane instead.
Scale in after drain, not merely after CPU falls

Scale down only after the campaign/recovery window ends and queue, outbox, payment-pending and expiry signals are healthy through a cooldown. Stop pulling work, finish or checkpoint the current item, then release its lease before termination.

Scale-to-zero fits intermittent analytics, reindex and bulk notifications. Retain a safe floor for checkout, inventory authority, outbox, expiry, reconciliation, provider callback handling and observability because their idle cost buys correctness and recovery time.
Elastic capacity xuyên suốt traffic lifecycle
Scale-out chỉ hữu ích cho work chạy song song được. Peak biết trước cần warm capacity theo lịch; lúc yên cần scale-in có drain an toàn thay vì scale-to-zero vô điều kiện.
Pre-warm peak biết trước; bound spike không biết trước

Campaign có lịch phải nâng critical-path floor trước giờ mở theo startup, cache warm-up và connection-pool time đã đo. Reactive autoscale chỉ bắt đầu sau khi demand xuất hiện, nên admission control phải che khoảng warm-up.
Traffic bất ngờ có thể scale gateway, read path và API stateless theo concurrency/request signal, nhưng không được admit checkout vượt budget mà inventory, database và PSP có thể drain an toàn.
Mỗi component dùng một scaling signal
UI/API theo request concurrency hoặc requests trên healthy target; queue consumer cần oldest-message age, input/output rate và partition skew; payment worker còn cần provider-concurrency cap.

Hot SKU, shared row, database lock hoặc ordered partition là synchronization point. Replica nhiều hơn chỉ giảm work xung quanh chứ không tăng serialized rate của key đó; phải dùng admission, quota, cell hoặc single-writer lane.
Scale-in sau drain, không chỉ khi CPU hạ

Chỉ scale down sau campaign/recovery window và khi queue, outbox, payment-pending, expiry signal khỏe qua cooldown. Stop pulling work, finish/checkpoint item hiện tại rồi release lease trước terminate.

Scale-to-zero phù hợp analytics, reindex và bulk notification gián đoạn. Giữ safe floor cho checkout, inventory authority, outbox, expiry, reconciliation, provider callback và observability vì idle cost của chúng mua correctness cùng recovery time.

transactions
Correctness across money and inventory
The database protects local invariants; idempotency, state machines and reconciliation protect the workflow around it.
Make commands repeatable
Persist idempotency key, request fingerprint and original response together. Reject key reuse with different parameters and define retention from the maximum retry window.
Represent pending and unknown outcomes explicitly. After a timeout, query authoritative provider state before retrying or compensating an irreversible action.
Keep invariants local
Put uniqueness, balance and legal state transitions in one transaction and enforce them with constraints, conditional updates or locks—not a cache lock.
Choose isolation from the anomaly to prevent. Serializable transactions can abort under contention, so the whole transaction needs a bounded retry path.
Close the distributed gap
Write business state and an outbox record atomically; consumers deduplicate effects. Exactly-once inside one platform does not make an external PSP or airline atomic.
Reconcile independent statements, retain immutable audit history and repair by compensating entries. Monitor aged pending states and unmatched totals as correctness SLIs.
Correctness xuyên suốt money và inventory
Database bảo vệ invariant local; idempotency, state machine và reconciliation bảo vệ workflow bao quanh nó.
Lưu idempotency key, request fingerprint và response gốc cùng nhau. Từ chối dùng lại key với parameter khác và đặt retention theo retry window dài nhất.
Biểu diễn pending/unknown thành state thật. Sau timeout phải query state authoritative từ provider trước khi retry hoặc compensate hành động khó đảo ngược.
Đưa uniqueness, balance và legal state transition vào một transaction, enforce bằng constraint, conditional update hoặc lock; không dùng cache lock cho correctness.
Chọn isolation theo anomaly cần chặn. Serializable có thể abort khi contention, vì vậy toàn transaction cần bounded retry path.
Ghi business state và outbox atomically; consumer deduplicate effect. Exactly-once trong một platform không làm PSP hay airline bên ngoài trở thành atomic.
Reconcile các statement độc lập, giữ audit history immutable và repair bằng compensating entry. Theo dõi pending quá tuổi và unmatched total như correctness SLI.

rate-limiting
Policy and distributed enforcement
A limiter protects a scarce resource; its key, cost model and failure mode matter more than the counter algorithm.
Model the budget
Scope by authenticated tenant/user/API key before IP where possible. Charge weighted cost for expensive queries instead of pretending every request costs one token.
Separate sustained rate, burst capacity and concurrency. Version policy and shadow new rules before enforcement to measure false positives.
Bound distributed error
Use atomic server-side updates for a precise shared bucket; use local token leases only when bounded overshoot is acceptable and measurable.
Choose fail-open or fail-closed per endpoint. Authentication, checkout and public reads have different abuse risk and availability cost.
Operate the control
Track allowed, rejected and shadow decisions by policy version plus limiter latency, hot keys and degraded-mode duration—without putting user IDs in metric labels.
Return a stable error contract and Retry-After where meaningful; combine rate limits with quotas, bot controls and origin concurrency protection.
Policy và distributed enforcement
Limiter bảo vệ resource khan hiếm; key, cost model và failure mode quan trọng hơn việc chọn counter algorithm.
Ưu tiên scope theo tenant/user/API key đã authenticate trước IP. Tính weighted cost cho query đắt thay vì coi mọi request tốn đúng một token.
Tách sustained rate, burst capacity và concurrency. Version policy và chạy shadow trước khi enforce để đo false positive.
Dùng update atomic phía server cho shared bucket chính xác; chỉ cấp token lease local khi bounded overshoot được chấp nhận và đo được.
Chọn fail-open/fail-closed theo endpoint. Authentication, checkout và public read có abuse risk cùng availability cost khác nhau.
Theo dõi allow/reject/shadow theo policy version, limiter latency, hot key và thời gian degraded mode; không đưa user ID vào metric label.
Trả error contract ổn định và Retry-After khi phù hợp; kết hợp rate limit với quota, bot control và concurrency protection tại origin.
